data.name: Aleydis
data.gender_notes: Aleydis is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin 'Aleidis', which translates to 'Noble, kind, gentle'. In Christian tradition, it is believed to be the name of a noble and virtuous woman mentioned in the New Testament. The name Aleydis carries the meaning “Noble, gentle, kind” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aleydis usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, gentle, kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Name of a virtuous Christian woman
data.etymology: Aleydis belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble, gentle, kind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aleydis total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: אלעדיס
in_hebrew.meaning: אלעדיס הוא שם נוצרי שמשמעותו 'אלוהים הוא השופט שלי'
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלעדיס הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו בשפה הגרמנית ומשמעותו 'אלוהים הוא השופט שלי'. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'אל' שפירושו אלוהים ו'עדיס' שפירושו שופט. השם אלעדיס נמצא בשימוש בעיקר במסורת הנוצרית הקתולית והוא נחשב לשם קדוש.

in_greek.name: Αλείδης
in_greek.meaning: Αλείδης σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι ο κριτής μου'
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αλείδης είναι χριστιανικό και προέρχεται από τη γερμανική γλώσσα. Η ετυμολογία του ονόματος βασίζεται σε δύο λέξεις: 'Αλ' που σημαίνει Θεός και 'είδης' που σημαίνει κριτής. Στην παράδοση της πρώιμης Χριστιανικής Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Αλείδης συνδέεται με την έννοια της κρίσεως και της προστασίας από τον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Aleydis
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Aleydis origine Germanico est et in traditione Christiana Catholica invenitur. Componitur ex duabus partibus: 'Ale' quod significat Deus et 'ydis' quod significat iudex. Nomen Aleydis in primo usu Ecclesiae Christianae antiquae, notionem iudicii et protectionis a Deo habet.

in_english.name: Aleydis
in_english.long_meaning: The Christian name Aleydis originates from Germanic roots and signifies 'God is my judge'. Etymologically, it is derived from two elements: 'Ale', meaning God, and 'ydis', meaning judge. Historically, Aleydis has been used primarily within the Catholic Christian tradition. The name carries spiritual significance as a declaration of faith in God's judgment and providence. It reflects a personal relationship with God as the ultimate authority in one's life.

data.cultural_impact: Aleydis, a name deeply rooted in European history, has been associated with nobility and elegance. In the Middle Ages, this name was often given to girls whose families were part of the aristocracy, emphasizing their noble lineage and refinement. Beyond its historical significance, Aleydis is a popular name in various European cultures, including French, Flemish, and Portuguese.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Aleydis holds a spiritual significance in Christian traditions, where it is believed that it was bestowed upon a virtuous woman mentioned in the New Testament. This woman, known as Alphena in some translations, is one of the four unnamed virgins mentioned in Matthew 25:1-13, representing the ideal Christian virtues of faith, hope, charity, and perseverance. Using this biblical context, the name Aleydis carries a profound and spiritual meaning, representing the embodiment of noble character and Christian virtues.
